routing.title: Discover, configure, and publish APIs
routing.description: Discover Service endpoints, configure governance, and apply changes together. A new runtime snapshot is saved only when the effective configuration changes.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHelp: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only

sections.productsDescription: Groups and versions are created from Service contracts when endpoints are first published. Manage their details and publication settings here.
sections.upstreamsDescription: Manage Services and their Targets. All endpoints are discovered from OpenAPI contracts.
sections.revisionsDescription: Platform saves a new immutable snapshot only when the effective traffic configuration changes; identical configuration reuses the active snapshot. This page is for audit and rollback only.

empty.productsDescription: Publish a Service endpoint from the endpoint list to create its group and version automatically.
empty.upstreamsDescription: Enter a Service Token and Target URL to connect your first Service.
empty.revisionsDescription: Save and apply the first Service Endpoint from the endpoint catalog to create the initial runtime snapshot.

runtime.defaultDomainHelp: Optional. Routes without their own Host answer on this domain. Leave it empty to make them the lowest-priority any-Host fallback. Saving republishes the runtime snapshot.

productForm.editDescription: Update the group name, description, visibility, and lifecycle.
productForm.slugHelp: Generated from the Service contract as a stable identifier for grouping and authorization.
productForm.summaryPlaceholder: Briefly describe what this group of endpoints provides

versionForm.description: Manage the publication state and changelog for {product}.
versionForm.versionHelp: The version number comes from the Service endpoint path and is managed automatically.

upstreamForm.title: Create Upstream
upstreamForm.description: Connect a service that implements the Service protocol with a Service Token and at least one Target.
upstreamForm.editDescription: Update the Upstream name, slug, and load-balancing strategy. Targets and tokens are managed separately.
upstreamForm.loadBalancingHelp: The initial runtime supports round robin and weighted round robin. Weights apply only in weighted mode.
upstreamForm.serviceTokenHelp: Use the same Token as the Service (32–4096 characters). Tokens are encrypted and excluded from runtime snapshots and logs.
upstreamForm.connectionDescription: Use a Service Token to verify the service identity, discover endpoints, and synchronize configuration.
upstreamForm.targetsDescription: Targets support private addresses, container names, HTTP, and HTTPS. Public HTTP is rejected; weighted mode distributes requests according to each weight.
upstreamForm.multiServiceTitle: One Upstream can connect multiple Service instances
upstreamForm.multiServiceDescription: Targets may run on different servers. Round robin fits equal instances; weighted round robin allocates traffic by capacity. Every Target in one Upstream must belong to the same logical Service and expose matching OpenAPI and configuration schemas.
upstreamForm.serviceTokenEditHelp: Leave blank to keep the current Token. Run Service discovery to verify a replacement before it is used for public traffic.

targetForm.description: Configure the service URL, weight, and traffic state for {upstream}.
targetForm.deferredAddressTitle: The new address activates only after discovery verifies it
targetForm.deferredAddressDescription: After saving, the runtime keeps using the previous address until the Service is synchronized. Make sure the new address is reachable.

routeForm.editDescription: The path and method come from the Service contract. Save governance settings, then apply all changes to activate them.
routeForm.namePlaceholder: For example, Get weather by city
routeForm.governanceDescription: The Platform Gateway applies these rules before forwarding. The API Service never receives caller API keys or manages credits. Zero means unlimited or free.
routeForm.creditsCostHelp: Only successful 2xx/3xx responses are charged. 4xx, 5xx, timeouts, and network failures release reserved credits.
routeForm.catalogStatusHelp: Automatic health uses recent calls; maintenance is shown explicitly in the public catalog.
routeForm.sensitiveQueryHelp: These query parameters are always redacted from call logs and referrers.
routeForm.sensitiveQueryPlaceholder: For example token, then press Enter
routeForm.stateHelp: Enabling and disabling take effect when you apply all changes.

rollback.title: Roll back to runtime snapshot #{sequence}
rollback.description: This immediately switches the Gateway to the historical snapshot. The current snapshot remains available and can be restored later.

toggleRoute.title: Disable this Route?
toggleRoute.description: The Route will stop accepting new public requests after it is disabled. Confirm that this is intended.

deleteProduct.title: Delete endpoint group: {name}
deleteProduct.description: Only groups without endpoints or references from the active runtime snapshot can be deleted.

deleteVersion.title: Delete version: {version}
deleteVersion.description: Only versions without endpoints or references from the active runtime snapshot can be deleted.

deleteUpstream.title: Delete Upstream: {name}
deleteUpstream.description: Only Upstreams without Routes and without references from the active runtime snapshot can be deleted.

toggleUpstream.title: Change Upstream state: {name}
toggleUpstream.description: Disabling the Upstream stops its active Routes from accepting new public requests.

deleteTarget.title: Delete Target
deleteTarget.description: The Target can be removed directly when another ready Target remains. An Upstream used by active Routes must keep at least one available Target.

toggleTarget.title: Change Target state: {name}
toggleTarget.description: This changes whether the Target receives traffic and Service configuration updates.

feedback.runtimeUpdated: The Gateway loaded the new configuration without a restart
feedback.runtimePending: The Route is saved and will enter the runtime snapshot when an eligible Target is available
feedback.activateFailed: Failed to roll back the runtime snapshot
feedback.runtimeUnchanged: The effective traffic configuration was unchanged, so the active runtime snapshot stays in place

validation.paidRouteRequiresGovernance: Paid Routes require API key authentication and call logs

serviceControl.pageDescription: Fetch the Service contract and configuration schema automatically. Business configuration remains separate from public Routes, credits, rate limits, and Routing Revisions.
serviceControl.connectionDescription: Discovery means the contract is stored. Runtime status checks both readiness and control-plane authentication for every Target.
serviceControl.lastDiscoveryErrorTitle: The latest discovery was not fully successful
serviceControl.replaceTokenDescription: The new Token is used for control-plane verification first; Gateway traffic keeps using the last verified Token. Rediscovery promotes it to the active Token.
serviceControl.tokenUpdateFailed: Failed to update the Service Token
serviceControl.rediscoverAfterToken: The connection is pending verification; rediscover and synchronize every Target
serviceControl.discoverySucceeded: Service contract and configuration schema synchronized
serviceControl.discoveryPartial: Service contract synchronized, but some Targets failed discovery
serviceControl.discoverFirstDescription: The Platform verifies every Target's Service ID, OpenAPI fingerprint, and configuration schema before enabling the generic form.
serviceControl.configurationDescription: Every field is declared by the Service; the Platform contains no business-specific form logic.
serviceControl.configurationDrifted: Desired configuration saved, but some Targets are not synchronized
serviceControl.configurationPartial: Configuration saved, but some Targets are not synchronized
serviceControl.configurationFailed: Configuration saved, but no Target synchronized successfully
serviceControl.secretBoundaryDescription: The browser only receives whether a secret is configured. Plaintext is encrypted at rest and decrypted only while sending it to the Service. Leave empty to preserve the current value.
serviceControl.secretConfiguredPlaceholder: Configured; leave empty to keep unchanged
serviceControl.targetsDescription: Runtime status checks readiness and Service Token authentication. Configuration status shows whether the Target has applied the Platform's desired configuration.
serviceControl.endpointsDescription: Discovered {count} business Endpoints. Discovery never creates or publishes public Routes automatically.
serviceControl.noEndpoints: The Service declares no business Endpoints yet

catalog.title: Endpoints
catalog.description: Select Service endpoints, save configuration changes, and apply them together. A new runtime snapshot is created only when the effective configuration changes.
catalog.contractMissing: This endpoint is no longer present in the Service contract. Review it before disabling or adjusting the Route.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search Services, paths, or endpoint names

feedback.changesPending: Endpoint saved. Apply all changes to activate it.
feedback.applyBlockedBy: Upstream {upstream} has no verified target; synchronize that Service first
